pages.text: The crucible's $(term)polarity$() ranges from -50 to 50 and begins at 0. The outer pointer on the upper-right HUD dial shows its current value.

pages.title: Changing Polarity Ⅰ
pages.text: In essence reaction, symbiosis lowers polarity by 2; mutual restraint raises it by 2; other essence relations leave it unchanged. Transmutation Decomposition and Essence Fusion do not change polarity.

pages.title: A Broken Balance
pages.text: $(warn)Take care:$() above +50, the crucible becomes a redstone block; below -50, it becomes an alchemical dross block. The contents drop, but the crucible is lost.
